Class OpenTimeRepository

java.lang.Object
com.andreibel.server.dbController.repository.OpenTimeRepository
public class OpenTimeRepository extends Object
Repository for accessing and managing the restaurant opening-hours configuration stored in the bistro.OpenTime table.

The table is modeled with a single "regular" configuration row (identified by id = 1) and optional "special day" configurations identified by their SpatialDate. A special day may override the regular configuration for a specific date.

This repository is JDBC-based and relies on TransactionManager to provide the current connection via TransactionManager.currentConnection(). All methods are expected to be called within an active transaction/context managed by TransactionManager.

  • Method Details

    • getInstance

      public static OpenTimeRepository getInstance()
      Returns the singleton instance of this repository.

      This repository is state-less and holds only a reference to the TransactionManager singleton.

      Returns:
      the singleton OpenTimeRepository instance

    • findRegular

      public OpenTime findRegular() throws SQLException
      Loads the "regular" (default) opening-hours configuration.

      By convention, the regular configuration is stored in bistro.OpenTime with id = 1. If the row does not exist, this method returns null.

      Returns:
      the regular OpenTime record, or null if not found
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • addNewSpecial

      public void addNewSpecial(LocalDate date, String title, LocalTime open, LocalTime close, int interval) throws SQLException
      Inserts a new "special day" opening-hours configuration for a specific calendar date.

      The created row will apply only for the provided date and can be used by higher-level logic to override the regular opening hours. The interval typically represents the reservation slot size in minutes.

      Parameters:
      date - the special date for which the opening hours apply
      title - human-readable title/description for the special day
      open - opening time for the given date
      close - closing time for the given date
      interval - slot interval (usually minutes) used for availability calculations
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the insert fails or a database access error occurs

    • updateRegular

      public void updateRegular(LocalTime open, LocalTime close, int interval) throws SQLException
      Updates the "regular" (default) opening-hours configuration.

      This method updates the row with id = 1. It does not affect any special-day rows. The interval typically represents the reservation slot size in minutes.

      Parameters:
      open - new default opening time
      close - new default closing time
      interval - new slot interval (usually minutes)
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the update fails or a database access error occurs

    • findSpecial

      public OpenTime findSpecial(Date date) throws SQLException
      Finds a special-day opening-hours configuration for the given date.

      If there is no special configuration for date, the method returns null. Callers typically fall back to findRegular() when this method returns null.

      Parameters:
      date - the calendar date to look up (as Date)
      Returns:
      the matching special-day OpenTime, or null if none exists
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs
